function.name: search_leads
function.description: Search for leads in the database by company name, city, status, tier, or any keyword. Returns matching leads with contact info and scores.

status.description: Filter by status: new, contacted, qualified, dead

score_tier.description: Filter by tier: hot, warm, cold, unqualified

function.name: get_lead_detail
function.description: Get complete detailed profile of a specific lead by ID, including decision makers, enrichment data, all contact info, and company details

function.name: get_lead_stats
function.description: Get comprehensive pipeline statistics: total leads, breakdown by tier/status/city/source, enrichment coverage

function.name: update_lead_status
function.description: Update the status of a lead by ID

note.description: Optional note about the status change

function.name: start_collection
function.description: Start collecting leads for an explicit MARKET search. Example: 'IT staffing companies in Pune'. Never pass a bare domain or a company-research, people-at-company, technology-user, or monitoring request; those require a specialized workflow.

function.name: find_people_at_company
function.description: Research named people in a specific function at ONE target company. Returns only candidates whose public profile result explicitly matches both the exact company and function, with provenance and confidence. Use this for requests like 'people on Stripe's partnerships team'; do not use broad lead collection.

company.description: Exact target company name or domain

function.description: Team/function, e.g. partnerships, alliances, sales, product

titles.description: Optional title queries; omit to use function-aware defaults

function.name: verify_people_at_company
function.description: Re-check an existing people-at-company result with fresh public searches. Distinguishes independent corroboration, LinkedIn/profile reconfirmation, and no fresh corroboration. This verifies role evidence, not contact ownership.

function.name: enrich_people_contacts
function.description: Find and verify work emails for the exact people already saved in this conversation. Uses stable person IDs, rejects generic domain contacts, records provider attempts, and requires approval before spending provider credits.

conversation_id.description: Current conversation ID containing the trusted people result

person_ids.description: Optional exact subset of stable person IDs; omit to enrich the full latest result

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable action key; retries with the same key reuse the stored result

function.name: create_people_workbook
function.description: Create a workbook from the exact latest people research, verification, or contact result stored in this conversation. Never re-sources companies. Requires approval.

conversation_id.description: Current conversation ID containing the trusted people result

person_ids.description: Optional exact subset of stable person IDs; omit to save the full latest result

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable action key; retries with the same key return the original workbook

function.name: enrich_lead
function.description: Trigger on-demand enrichment for a specific lead: scrape their website for contact info, find social profiles

function.name: find_similar_leads
function.description: Find leads similar to a given lead by matching industry/specialization and city

function.name: get_enrichment_gaps
function.description: Show leads that are missing key data: email, phone, LinkedIn, or decision makers. Helps prioritize enrichment.

min_score.description: Only show leads with score >= this

function.name: suggest_outreach
function.description: Generate a personalized cold outreach message (email or LinkedIn) for a specific lead

function.name: compare_leads
function.description: Compare 2-3 leads side-by-side with scoring breakdown, data completeness, and recommendation

lead_ids.description: List of 2-3 lead IDs to compare

function.name: ambitionbox_search
function.description: Search up to 100 AmbitionBox companies with ratings, reviews, employee counts, industry, and job data. For 'top N' requests, set limit=N; results are fetched across multiple 20-company pages. HR/Human Resources/Staffing map to Recruitment, and SaaS maps to Software Product. Supports filters: industry, rating. NOTE: there is no location/city filter — AmbitionBox's gateway ignores it. Do not claim results are scoped to a city.

industry.description: Industry filter, e.g. 'Recruitment', 'Human Resources', 'Software Product', 'IT Services & Consulting', 'Banking', 'BPO'

rating.description: Minimum rating, e.g. '4.5' for 4.5+ rated companies

limit.description: Total number of companies to return across pages (1-100). Set this to the count requested by the user.

function.name: ambitionbox_jobs
function.description: Get current job listings for a specific company from AmbitionBox. Includes job titles, skills, experience, locations.

company_id.description: AmbitionBox company ID (get from ambitionbox_search results)

function.name: import_ambitionbox_to_workbook
function.description: Start a durable, checkpointed import of AmbitionBox company results into a new workbook. Use this after ambitionbox_search when the user asks to add/save/import 'them' or 'those companies'. Repeat the same industry, rating, sort_by, and limit; page retries resume without duplicate rows. Do NOT use create_source_workbook for AmbitionBox results. Requires user approval.

industry.description: The same industry used in ambitionbox_search, e.g. 'Human Resources'

rating.description: The same minimum rating used in ambitionbox_search, if any

sort_by.description: The same sort order used in ambitionbox_search

limit.description: Number of matching companies to snapshot (1-100)

function.name: create_source_workbook
function.description: Create a LIVE-sourcing workbook that finds NEW leads from scratch via the 91-source engine. Use when the user wants to FIND/SOURCE companies (not save a list they already found). Example: 'Build a workbook of IT staffing companies in Pune'. For results already returned by ambitionbox_search, use import_ambitionbox_to_workbook instead. Optionally auto-runs sourcing immediately.

icp_description.description: Who to find, incl. geo. e.g. 'IT staffing companies in Pune, 50-500 employees'

auto_enrich.description: After sourcing, automatically run enrichment/agent columns (default false)

account_discovery.description: Require a complete server-parsed account discovery brief and strict evidence gating

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable action key; retries return the original workbook

function.name: set_workbook_refresh
function.description: Make a workbook 'living' — re-source new matches and re-enrich stale data on a schedule. Example: 'refresh this weekly'.

function.name: add_agent_column
function.description: Add a goal-directed AGENT column that dynamically picks tools to achieve a goal per row (e.g. 'find the verified CEO email'), with a cost/step budget and reasoning trace.

goal.description: What the agent should find, e.g. 'Find the verified email of the CEO'

function.name: add_signal_trigger
function.description: Trigger a workbook to refresh when buying signals fire (hiring, funding, tech change, news). Example: 'when any of these start hiring, refresh and find the hiring manager'.

signals.description: Signal types that trigger a refresh

function.name: track_account_signals
function.description: Create or update one recurring tracking schedule for exact persisted workbook account IDs. Use for account-level partnership hiring, leadership, funding, and pricing-page change monitoring. Requires approval and returns a database-confirmed receipt.

function.name: draft_grounded_outreach
function.description: Persist a short draft-only partnership email for one exact saved contact. Requires verified contact evidence, or explicit approval for a risky address. Generic and role inboxes are rejected. Every personalized sentence retains saved evidence. This tool never sends.

function.name: draft_plan
function.description: For COMPOUND goals that need several steps (e.g. 'build a list of 50 IT staffing firms in Pune and find their founders' emails'), draft a step-by-step plan WITHOUT executing it. Returns the plan for the user to review. Do not use for single actions.

goal.description: The high-level goal in the user's words

function.name: execute_plan
function.description: Execute a plan previously produced by draft_plan. Pass the plan_id and nonce returned by draft_plan (the server executes the plan it stored under that plan_id). This builds the workbook, sources companies, and runs agent-column enrichment. Requires user approval.

nonce.description: The single-use nonce returned by draft_plan

plan.description: (Optional, for display only) the plan object returned by draft_plan; the server executes the stored plan by plan_id, not this body
